utterances.text: Watch the road. Watch the road.
Is not— is not going to yelling at us?
I don't know. First driving lesson you got. Pay attention. What would you do if a car came?
I'll stop. I think the sensor is beeping, should I—
Say, 'Papa, take over fast, here comes a car.' No? Or are you going to drive it anyway? Stop worrying about the bells and whistles and look at the asphalt.
No... you're being totally mid right now, just let me drive.
Mid? What is a mid? Speak English and swipe the road!
